overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 3 of 4 positive reasoning segments with no segment-level false alarms; all four are detected when low-confidence identified findings are included.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict scoring yields 1 true positive, 4 false negatives, and 3 false positives (precision 0.2500, recall 0.2000, F1 0.2222).
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first scoring yields 4 true positives, 1 false negative, and no false positives (precision 1.0000, recall 0.8000, F1 0.8889).
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The authority-bias candidate is a cautious, validly quoted near miss, but it does not independently establish a hidden mechanism and adds one instance-level false positive at the candidate-inclusive threshold.
main_failure_modes: Four correctly localized findings use near-neighbor labels rather than the hidden target labels, creating a large strict-versus-mechanism-first taxonomy gap.
The low-confidence intake finding is missed at the recommended high_and_moderate threshold.
The candidate tier adds unsupported authority-bias speculation without improving hidden-instance recall.
main_strengths: The RAG output is valid, internally count-consistent, and all supplied interview quotations are valid.
All five hidden mechanisms are localized correctly and are recovered under mechanism-first scoring when all identified confidence levels are included.
The groupthink occurrence is an exact strict match at moderate confidence, and no segment-level false alarms occur.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong evidence and mechanism recovery but weak exact-label alignment. The recommended high_and_moderate comparison threshold captures most substantive instances while avoiding candidate-level speculation; the taxonomy gap should be reported separately from detection quality.
